summary: Ship the worktree guard as a managed file and fail closed without its runner

delivery.outcome: An adopter holds the guard as a tracked file, and a hook whose runner is gone refuses the commit instead of passing it
nonGoals: No change to the overlap checker

architecture.decision: install-worktree-guard.sh copied the runner in as untracked files. Twice in one day a git clean removed them from subactor/core and subactor/www-sub-actor while the wired pre-commit survived, leaving a gate that looked installed and enforced nothing - it exited zero with no runner to exec. Shipping the guard through package-manifest.json makes an adopter hold it as a tracked, versioned file, and the fragment now exits non-zero with remediation when the runner is absent. The adoption fixture copies the repository root config too, because a fixture that omits what the package ships tests a standard that does not exist.
architecture.rollback: Remove the three manifest entries and restore the fragment's silent exit

validation.evidence: A built adopter contains the guard runner, checker and config as managed files
With the runner present the fragment exits 0; with it deleted the fragment exits 1 and names the remediation, instead of the silent pass observed twice today
